resources.string: Let PC-side AI (Cline / Claude Desktop) control this phone over streamable HTTP
⚠️ Traffic is plain HTTP — anyone on the same network can intercept it. Default binding is loopback-only (127.0.0.1); PC clients need this switch on a trusted network (an SSH tunnel is safer).

Off by default: file writes, git commits and other side-effect tools are not exposed to external AI; read-only tools are unaffected. High-risk tools (delete / uninstall / force-stop) are never exposed.

Starts a local HTTP server on port %1$d. Every request must carry the bearer token. Default binding is loopback-only; only read-only tools are exposed by default (write tools need their own switch, high-risk tools are never exposed).
Connected clients will be rejected on their next request. You must update the token in every client config.
Only tools in allowed categories are exposed to external AI. Default set is read-friendly; high-risk categories are off.
Dangerous categories enabled (SHELL / TERMINAL / APP / UI / GITHUB / SECURITY): an external agent can act directly on your phone. Enable with care.
vault_* tools are ALWAYS blocked locally (security vault never leaves the phone). Config blacklist: %1$s

Add this server in Cline / Claude Desktop (mcp-remote) with the JSON below. Phone and PC must be on the same LAN with "Allow LAN access" enabled (default binding is loopback-only); keep this app alive while connected.
